comparison_level: Complete 16 MiB RAM and all GPRs, SR, PR, and return PC compared against the retail SH-4 interpreter.
scope: The 14-byte routine at 0x8c019368 sign-extends the low byte in R4 and R5, then stores those 32-bit values to literal destinations 0x8c6b7084 and 0x8c6b7088. Tests cover signed-byte boundaries, discarded upper register bits, varied memory, and varied CPU state.
limitations: Uses the project SH-4 interpreter rather than Dreamcast hardware or end-to-end gameplay.
The two global fields’ higher-level ownership and game behavior remain unidentified.
